segments.name: Technology research and advisory
segments.description: A global AI-centered technology research and advisory firm providing digital transformation, sourcing advisory, research and platform solutions to private- and public-sector clients.
segments.evidence: ISG is a leading global provider of digital transformation and technology advisory services, helping organizations optimize performance, reduce costs, and accelerate innovation.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay ISG fees for professional services, either based on time and materials at agreed hourly rates or under fixed-fee contract structures.
revenueModel.evidence: We principally derive revenues from fees for services generated on a project-by-project basis.
